title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-08
source: MR (Dick Latvala) > DAT > SoundForge (Jim Wise) > CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by a stellar Dark Star and the early “Main Ten” jam.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the soaring jams, especially the Dark Star trek and the rare Main Ten (an embryonic Playing In The Band) that showcase the band at a creative peak. The soundboard source is praised as clear and well‑balanced, with no technical complaints beyond missing tracks in the archive. Overall it’s regarded as an outstanding 1969 performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance (70% weight) and soundboard clarity (30% weight) across multiple reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No listeners noted audio flaws; the soundboard is described as clear and well‑balanced. Complaints focus on missing songs in the archive, not on the recording itself.

standout_songs: "Main Ten" (early Playing In The Band jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Epic flow with a remarkable Dark Star journey and a seamless Main Ten segment; fans consider the set list unbeatable for this era.
